messages:
Priya (AM): Quick heads-up — Vertex Labs is evaluating switching from MacroAI to Redwood. They asked for a short POC to prove minimal app changes, pricing delta for ~250M tokens/month, and answers to their security questionnaire. Can SE + Eng own technical presales?

Jordan (SE): Happy to lead. Do they need an API-compat shim or are they ok changing the client?

Mei (Solutions): They explicitly want minimal app changes. Prefer a transparent shim that accepts MacroAI payloads and forwards to Redwood with param mappings. Also they use streaming and function calling heavily — those are areas to call out.

Omar (Eng): We can produce a small Docker shim that maps endpoints and rewrites streaming SSE to MacroAI chunk format. I can spin up a prototype in 48 hours. We'll include a small eval harness (25 canonical prompts) to check semantic drift.

Lina (Security): FYI their questionnaire asks about KMS integration, data retention, and VPC peering. For hosted POC we can offer 30-day log retention and redact stored user content. For Dedicated, they can bring their KMS and VPC. I can draft answers and an appendix.

Priya (AM): Perfect. They also want a ballpark committed pricing vs hosted PAYG. Jordan, can you pull a quick estimate for 250M tokens?

Jordan (SE): Ballpark: hosted gen costs ~ $0.0009/token -> ~$225k/mo. Committed Dedicated would reduce effective unit to ~ $0.0005-$0.0006/token depending on commit -> maybe ~$125k-$150k/mo plus infra fee. I'll flag to finance for a firm quote.

Mei (Solutions): We'll also prepare a short migration checklist for their app owners: tokenization checks, prompt length limits, streaming shape, and function-call schema differences. That helps them estimate engineering effort.

Omar (Eng): Implementation notes: MacroAI uses param "max_tokens" and expects incremental delta counts; Redwood uses "max_new_tokens" and we have slightly different tokenizer boundaries. Include a note on token-count diffs. I'll produce the shim repo link when ready.

deploy-bot: Deployment pipeline created for shim-proxy (ci:shim-vertexlab) — build queued.

Lina (Security): Attaching SOC2 excerpt and VPC onboarding doc in the email draft. Priya please share Vertex main contact and whether they want hosted or dedicated pilot.

Priya (AM): Contact is rachel@vertexlabs.ai. They prefer hosted POC first, then Dedicated if parity looks good. Jordan + Omar can you commit to starting Monday?

Jordan (SE): Confirmed.

Omar (Eng): Confirmed, prototype ready in 48h, full POC by EOW.

Priya (AM): Great — I'll intro to Rachel now and include the timeline and next steps.

Mei (Solutions): I'll add a one-pager on enterprise blockers to the POC deliverables: function-call parity, streaming event format, tokenization edge cases, and recommended mitigation steps.

Lina (Security): I'll prepare the RFP answers and an NDA template to attach.

Priya (AM): Thanks team :thumbsup:
